caption:
$1,000 off your taxable income, no receipts needed, from this income year.

The new standard deduction applies automatically from 2026–27 for residents earning wages or other labour income. It's not in your 2025–26 return. Work costs you claim cut it dollar for dollar, so under $1,000 of costs gets you $1,000 either way. Spend more and keep the records? Claim the lot instead. Union and tax agent fees are claimed on top.

On the 30% rate it's worth about $320 including Medicare.

Save this for July 2027.

General info only, not personal advice.
